source_contract: `CmdSignalTrackHelper(DoCommandFlags flags, TileIndex tile, TileIndex end_tile, Track track, SignalType sigtype, SignalVariant sigvar, bool mode, bool remove, bool autofill, bool minimise_gaps, int signal_density)` (src/rail_cmd.cpp).
reason: Plan #1046 part 2 decision 1 gives each long helper an argument struct with the original's parameters in name and order; CmdSignalTrackHelper has four bool parameters. Base rail_cmd.rs allowed clippy::fn_params_excessive_bools on the whole module for the same parameters as positional arguments.
retirement_condition: Retires when the rail command table is ported and CmdBuildSignalTrack and CmdRemoveSignalTrack pass their own argument structs to the helper.
